frontmatter.title: BTech in Artificial Intelligence — Curriculum by Semester

chunks.heading: Program Credit Summary
chunks.text:
Program Credit Summary
The BTech in Artificial Intelligence program requires a total of 129 credits, completed across 8 semesters over 4 years.

chunks.heading: Year 1, Semester 1
chunks.text:
Year 1, Semester 1
Total credit for this semester: 18. Courses: AICC101 Introduction to Intelligent Systems; AIPC101 Introduction to Programming; AIMA101 Calculus; AIMA102 Probability and Statistics; AIME101 Ethics and Professional Conduct; AIMC101 Advanced Communication Skills.

chunks.heading: Year 1, Semester 2
chunks.text:
Year 1, Semester 2
Total credit for this semester: 17. Courses: AIPC102 Object-Oriented Programming; AICS101 Data Structures and Algorithms; AIMA103 Discrete Structures; AIMA104 Linear Algebra; AICC102 Introduction to Cognitive Science; AISP121 Semester Project I.

chunks.heading: Year 2, Semester 1
chunks.text:
Year 2, Semester 1
Total credit for this semester: 17. Courses: AICS201 Database Management Systems; AICS202 Design and Analysis of Algorithms; AICC201 Artificial Intelligence; AICC202 Introduction to Data Science; AIMA201 Differential Equations; AISP211 Semester Project II.

chunks.heading: Year 2, Semester 2
chunks.text:
Year 2, Semester 2
Total credit for this semester: 17. Courses: AICS203 Software Engineering; AIMA202 Optimization Theory; AIMA203 Numerical Methods; AICC203 Introduction to Machine Learning; AIPC201 Programming Paradigms for AI; AISP222 Semester Project III.

chunks.heading: Year 3, Semester 1
chunks.text:
Year 3, Semester 1
Total credit for this semester: 17. Courses: AICC302 Pattern Recognition; AICC301 Data Mining; AICL318 Cloud Computing and AI; AICS301 Computer Networks and Cyber Security; AIMI301 Innovative Entrepreneurship; AISP311 Semester Project IV.

chunks.heading: Year 3, Semester 2
chunks.text:
Year 3, Semester 2
Total credit for this semester: 16. Courses: AICC303 Advanced Machine Learning; AICL311 Image Processing; AICL316 (Elective) Information Retrieval; AICL317 (Elective) Embedded Systems; AISP322 Semester Project V; AISM311 Seminar; AIMA331 Advanced Calculus and Statistics.

chunks.heading: Year 4, Semester 1
chunks.text:
Year 4, Semester 1
Total credit for this semester: 15. Courses: AICC401 Deep Learning; AIMA431 Fuzzy Network and Sequencing; AICL434 Large Language Models; AICL460 IoT and Blockchain; AIIN411 Industrial Preparation; AISP411 Semester Project VI.

chunks.heading: Year 4, Semester 2
chunks.text:
Year 4, Semester 2
Total credit for this semester: 12. Courses: Elective VII (AICL), 3 credits; AIMS401 AI and Society, 3 credits; AIIN412 Industrial Internship, 6 credits.
